info.name: CatchWatch - Live Cricket User APIs (Clean Architecture)
info.description:
Complete user-facing REST APIs for CatchWatch Live Cricket Streaming, Scoreboard, Crease Polling (Striker/Non-Striker/Bowler), Commentary, Squads, and Full Scorecard.

✨ CLEAN ARCHITECTURE (Single Data Ownership):
- Listing APIs return only listing metadata.
- Match Details API (`/:matchId`) is called ONCE when opening the player screen.
- Live Activity API (`/:matchId/live-activity`) is ultra-lightweight (<500 bytes) for 3-5 second polling.
- Dedicated tab APIs for Scorecard, Commentary, and Squads prevent redundant data transfer.

Compatible with Flutter, iOS (Swift), and Web.

item.name: 3. Live Crease Polling & Detail Tabs
item.description: Lightweight sub-endpoints designed specifically for high-frequency polling and tab-based navigation.

request.description:
⚡ ULTRA LIGHTWEIGHT (~400 bytes):
Poll this every 3 to 5 seconds during a LIVE match.
Returns ONLY changing real-time data: scores (teamA, teamB), CRR, RRR, target, striker (name, runs, balls, 4s, 6s, SR), nonStriker (name, runs, balls), bowler (name, overs, maidens, runs, wickets, economy), recentBalls, overStatusText, and lastUpdated.
No video stream URLs, no full scorecard, no squads.
